pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Dark contiguous regions exhibit sub-polygonal geometry with low-contrast, blurred edge gradients. Spatial area of individual patches is small relative to the total visible flank.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: Inter-patch pathways consist of thin, light-colored pixel bands forming a high-frequency lattice. Junction nodes are frequent and exhibit continuity across the visible epidermis.
